title: A computational investigation on transition metal substituted two-dimensional pentagonal nickel diazenide (NiN2) for the hydrogen evolution reaction via water splitting
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, 9,4748-4760
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE00728C, Paper
Suwathaa Venkataprabha, M. Amrutha, Jeganathan Kulandaivel, Brahmananda Chakraborty
Two-dimensional pentagonal nickel diazenide (NiN2) has drawn significant attention as a promising electrocatalyst for the hydrogen evolution reaction (HER), owing to its unique structural and electronic properties.
